case_goal: Enrol user 'UserU' into a course by searching for 'Math' and completing the enrolment.
summary: The test navigates to Claroline, logs in with user 'UserU', clicks 'Enrol on a new course', searches for 'Math', clicks the enrolment icon for the Math course, and verifies the enrolment confirmation page.

steps.expected_result: Page loads with login form and category links.
After login, user sees logged-in menu with 'Enrol on a new course' link.

steps.target: link text: Enrol on a new course
steps.expected_result: Page displays course enrolment options and a search field.
Search results show a course with 'Math' and an enrolment icon (a > img).
Enrolment is completed, page shows 'Back to my personal course list' link.
Element exists, confirming successful enrolment message.
